research_question: Can a completed I7 five-minute failed-session-auction confirmation replace only the final one-minute impulse requirement while preserving unanimous peer transfer, efficient standardized causal displacement and top-half market price discovery?

freeze_provenance.timing_statement: The strategy and all thresholds were frozen before any H01-H16 outcome was opened. This protocol is a mechanical compilation of the committed reservation onto the exact frozen strategy source commit.

hypothesis.scdam_core: Byte-identical Candidate 13 FAR/AAC semantic policy. No SCDAM condition is relaxed.
hypothesis.session_aac: Byte-identical V4 AAC admission. The final one-minute impulse remains required.

session_far.local_confirmation: The frozen I7 five-minute rejection/MSS route is already complete, so the terminal one-minute impulse is not required a second time.
session_far.market_requirements: All three peers must move in the proposed direction; the candidate causal path must pass the existing efficiency and pre-event-volatility displacement floors; event direction rank must be in the top half of four markets.
session_far.countertrend_role: Candidate and median market trailing scores are adverse but not jointly severe; approve a completed countertrend transfer.
session_far.trend_resumption_role: Candidate and median market trailing scores already align with the plan and candidate trailing rank is in the top half; approve a completed session-raid trend resumption.

hypothesis.no_new_threshold: The frozen system reuses existing efficiency, standardized displacement, severe-adverse score and categorical top-half ranks. It adds no fitted magnitude or route whitelist.
hypothesis.portfolio: Both modules retain one GlobalCandidateMutex, one exact current-NAV 3% planned-loss sizer and one NautilusTrader account.

selection.method: For each calendar quarter from 2022Q1 through 2025Q4, select one eligible Monday-start seven-day interval with Python random.Random(seed), excluding every interval whose three-day warmup through evaluation end overlaps exposed Candidate 12 W1-W6 or Candidate 14 W10-W14 evaluation data.

claim_rules: No strategy, threshold, order, cost, risk, target, stop, session route, semantic or arbitration change is permitted after the reservation.
All 16 intervals must complete under exact candidate, protocol and source provenance.
Any strategy change invalidates H01-H16 and requires different untouched intervals.
Passing this non-contiguous holdout is necessary but not sufficient for live readiness; a continuous frozen evaluation must follow.
